senses.gloss: f. (= אִסְפַּלְעָנִית or אִסְבְּלָנִית, Ispe. noun of בלע or בלי; cmp. בְּלִיתָא, a. סִיפְלָני; פ dialect. for ב, induced by preceding sibilant) rag, plaster, compress (for softening or healing).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 133b:16">ib. 133ᵇ</cite> seven portions of fat and one portion of wax).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 3:1:5">Y. Orl. III, beg. 62ᵈ</cite> <he>העושה א׳ וכ׳</he> he who makes a plaster of the fat of &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:58">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵈ</cite> top <he>הממרח את הא׳</he> he who spreads a plaster.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:23">Tosef. Sabb. I, 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 44:1">Pesik. R. s. 44</cite> <he>איספלניס</he> (corr. acc.). [Σπληνίον, in Hippocr., seems to be a Greek adaptation of our w.]
